newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine sets copper exploration tender for June.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sets copper exploration tender for June.

text.p: Ukraine's State Geology Committee announced on Friday an international tender on June 21 for exploration and development rights to a copper deposit in western Ukraine, the committee's press service said on Friday.
It said the winner would receive five-year exploration rights and 20-year mining rights on the 32-square-hectare deposit, in the Volyn region 500 km west of Kiev.
No details were available on tender terms.
Ukraine has targeted copper output of 300,000 tonnes a year by 2000, after output of 50,000 tonnes in 1994, the last year for which the government made figures available.
